name: nbody
algorithm: Five-body leapfrog in f64, structure of arrays, steps of 0.0078125; the checksum is the final energy times 1e9 truncated to an integer (README.md).

skip.mk-wrap: the hot loop has no integer arithmetic beyond loop counters, so a wrapping column would equal mk

no_counts: B24: no data-dependent control flow; steps * 10 pair updates, and the energy checksum is sensitive to every operation order
